Keto 5-Day Meal Prep Plan Overview
This plan provides breakfast, lunch, dinner, and one snack daily for one person, keeping net carbs under 20g per day with high-fat (70-80%), moderate-protein (15-25%) macros. Total daily calories average 1500-1600, adjustable by portion size. All meals are prep-friendly, using batch cooking on Sunday (total prep time: 2-3 hours).

Keto Meal Prep Foundations
Portions serve one; scale proteins/fats for your needs. Focus on whole foods with some convenience items. Daily net carbs: 15-18g. Prep tips: Cook proteins/veggies in bulk, portion into containers. Store in fridge (up to 5 days) or freeze extras. Use avocado oil, butter, olive oil for fats. Track with an app like Cronometer for precision[1][4][5].

5-Day Meal Schedule and Prep Times

| Day | Breakfast (Prep: 5-10 min) | Lunch (Prep: 10-15 min) | Dinner (Prep: 20-30 min) | Snack (Prep: 5 min) | Total Daily Prep |
|-----|----------------------------|-------------------------|--------------------------|---------------------|------------------|
| Monday | 2 boiled eggs + 2 tbsp butter + 1/2 avocado (10g fat, 12g protein, 3g net carbs) | Romaine wraps: 4oz turkey, 2oz cheddar, 1 tbsp mayo, mustard, 5 cherry tomatoes (20g fat, 25g protein, 4g net carbs) | Pulled pork (1lb slow-cook shoulder) + coleslaw (1 cup cabbage, 2 tbsp mayo) (40g fat, 30g protein, 5g net carbs) | 1oz dark chocolate (85%+) (15g fat, 2g net carbs) | 45 min |
| Tuesday | 3 sausage patties + 1oz cheese (25g fat, 20g protein, 2g net carbs) | Charcuterie: 2oz salami, 2oz cheese, 10 olives, 1/4 cup pickles (30g fat, 20g protein, 3g net carbs) | Mushroom alfredo: 4oz shirataki noodles, 1/2 cup mushrooms, 1/4 cup heavy cream, 1 tbsp butter + roasted green beans (35g fat, 15g protein, 5g net carbs) | 10 macadamia nuts (20g fat, 2g net carbs) | 50 min |
| Wednesday | Ham & cheese omelet: 3 eggs, 2oz ham, 1oz cheese (30g fat, 25g protein, 2g net carbs) | Caesar salad: 4oz chicken, romaine, 2 tbsp dressing, 1oz parm (25g fat, 30g protein, 4g net carbs) | Sheet-pan salmon (6oz) + broccoli (1 cup) in 2 tbsp butter (40g fat, 35g protein, 4g net carbs) | Celery sticks + 2 tbsp cream cheese (15g fat, 1g net carbs) | 45 min |
| Thursday | Bulletproof coffee: 1 tbsp butter, 1 tbsp MCT oil, black coffee (fast-friendly alt) + 2oz bacon (25g fat, 10g protein, 1g net carbs) | Tuna salad: 5oz tuna, 2 tbsp mayo, celery, lettuce (30g fat, 25g protein, 3g net carbs) | Mississippi pot roast (8oz chuck, slow-cook with butter) + cauliflower mash (1 cup cauli, 2 tbsp cream) (45g fat, 30g protein, 5g net carbs) | 1/2 avocado + salt (15g fat, 2g net carbs) | 60 min (batch roast) |
| Friday | Frittata muffins (batch: 6 eggs, spinach, 2oz cheese for 5 days) + 2 bacon strips (25g fat, 20g protein, 2g net carbs) | Leftover pot roast salad wrap (20g fat, 25g protein, 3g net carbs) | Chicken thighs (6oz baked) + zucchini noodles in pesto (2 tbsp) (40g fat, 30g protein, 4g net carbs) | Pork rinds (1oz) + guac (1 tbsp) (15g fat, 1g net carbs) | 40 min |

Batch prep instructions: Sunday - Boil eggs/sausage (20 min), slow-cook pork/roast (2 hrs hands-off), roast veggies (30 min), chop salads. Reheat as needed[1][5][7].

Complete Shopping List for One Person
Proteins (buy fresh/frozen): 1lb pork shoulder, 8oz chuck roast, 6oz salmon, 6 chicken thighs, 4oz turkey, 5oz tuna, 2oz ham, 2oz salami, 1lb breakfast sausage, 6oz bacon, 12 eggs.
Dairy/Fats: 8oz cheddar, 4oz parm, 8oz cream cheese, 1 cup heavy cream, 1/2 lb butter, 1 avocado (x5), 1 jar mayo, 1 bottle MCT oil, 2oz macadamia nuts, pork rinds.
Veggies: 1 head romaine, 1 cabbage, 1 cup mushrooms, 1lb green beans/broccoli, 1 cauliflower head, 2 zucchinis, celery, 1 pint cherry tomatoes, spinach bag, pickles/olives.
Pantry: Shirataki noodles, mustard, caesar dressing, pesto, dark chocolate (85%+, 1 bar), avocado oil.
